claim.purpose: Add atomic typed terminal plan-step repair and correct #5516 SPP S3

findings.summary: Initial cross-issue repair authority did not require exact target-path ownership.
Initial terminal receipt compare-and-swap was not serialized across worktrees.
Initial repair lacked repeatable Store-level atomicity and stale-CAS coverage.
Terminal reconciliation and generic recovery could write common receipts outside the global terminal lock.
Terminal reconciliation exposed a projection swap before its recovery journal was durable.
